smTO Manual

smTO uses the model to interpret requests and choose tools, with durable execution and actual result receipts.

For a new installation, start with Install and startup, then follow the UI tour. The architecture overview explains the main components; request lifecycle follows a request through them.

Developers can use the source map to find the owner of a behavior, then read the tool contract, tool discovery, and skill authoring guide. The contributor workflow describes documentation and regression checks.

Choose Agent to carry out work, Plan to inspect and propose changes, or Ask for advice without external execution. The current picker hides the compatibility Conversation mode. Review the selected Gateway and Permission Policy before submitting work; the UI tour explains mode controls and how an approved plan becomes implementation work.

The Historical group contains prior implementation records. Current guidance is in Product Manual and Architecture Guide.

For virtual machines and containers, see Using Proxmox VE. Proxmox is optional and disabled by default; the guide covers enabling it, adding a server parameter and making requests through the selected Gateway.

Use Model Configuration to assign Main and Helper models, configure their generation settings, and understand fallback and the configuration retained by accepted tasks.

Use Inference management to install, build, configure and launch managed model instances on Linux, connect them to the agent, and inspect caching and logs. The guide explains source installation and the two compiled variants.

For recurring or reusable work, see Schedules, Monitors and Workflows. Attachments and Vision explains accepted inputs and image analysis; Parameters and Database explains reusable values and exact tool inputs.
